caption: Doppler shift across a pass: the satellite's signal arrives a few kHz high while it approaches, slides through the published frequency at closest approach, and ends low as it recedes — which is why you keep adjusting your tuning.
spoken: An S-shaped curve of received frequency versus time: the signal starts a few kilohertz above the published frequency as the satellite approaches, crosses it at closest approach, and ends below as the satellite moves away.
